title: ia doctor names the removal for a hook group changed by hand, and two help lines are corrected
summary: For a registered hook group deleted, changed or duplicated by hand, the `ia doctor --host <host> --json` session briefing told the session to run `ia host <host> --apply`, which refuses that state. Its notice, context line and `nextActions` now name `ia host <host> --remove --apply` first and then `ia host <host> --apply`, as the doctor row already did. `ia author --help` no longer lists `ia author system <name>`, a form that always refuses with `IA-CLI-EDIT-AUTHORITY`, and the `--digest` option no longer says it is optional for it. `ia init --help` shows `--host` with `--decline`, which accepts it, rather than with `--forget-decline`, which refuses it. The moved-home doctor warning now reads "the per-OS location earlier releases used" in place of an internal milestone id. No other output changes.
